D13_lever_context.note: staged cuts PEAK intact-reentry to ~1/3 while retaining the debris benefit; cumulative<1 is a 26-yr horizon artifact, not a lost-fleet effect - in the limit both dispose N (staging moves timing, not total).

ruling: Staging the wind-down 5->15 yr (the D6-reconciled design point) leaves R1 (terminal-disposal principal) UNCHANGED and TRIPLES R3 (f2 through-window opex exposure): N*5 -> N*15 sat-yr. R1 is a per-object terminal cost; R3 is a per-object-year flow cost - only the flow cost is taper-sensitive. The trust sized against the staged wind-down = R1 principal (invariant floor) + R3 opex reserve (tripled, needs-data rate). D14's $0.76B floor and the covered-vs-aspirational split are unaffected. Second-order (flagged, not priced): a 15-yr reserve is drawn down over 15 yr not 5, so its present value/carry differs from a naive 3x of an annual rate - immaterial while the per-sat-yr rate is needs-data.
